Repeated React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' floods the console on many pages — indicates a .map() somewhere uses non-unique keys. Not introduced by iter50 but should be tracked.

action_items: Remove the duplicate Per-Location Monthly Revenue Targets grid (and duplicate data-testid='location-targets-grid') from the Expansion Module Weights section in AdvancedConfigSection.js (lines ~371-381).

AdvancedConfigSection.js: NumberField inside the location-targets grid uses key={l.id}; if orgLocations ever contains two entries with the same id, it would trigger the duplicate-key warning. Consider defensive de-dup.
Widespread 'duplicate key' console warnings across pages suggest one or more list renders (likely notifications/dashboard cards) use array index or non-unique ids — hunt via React devtools.
